panels.image: Night kitchen lit only by the bright glow of an open fridge. The mother stands in front of the open fridge in pyjamas, eyes half closed and very sleepy, hair a bit messy under the hijab, holding one cucumber and looking longingly at the full shelves (cheese, dates, leftovers, cake). A baby monitor glows on the counter and a wall clock shows 3 o'clock. Funny, relatable, cosy
